scope: Floating Image Studio prompt dock behavior for long and pasted prompts. Local implementation review and production build; no production deployment or authenticated browser session claimed.
decision: Keep the floating dock anchored to the viewport, let the prompt editor grow upward with the content, preserve bottom-aligned actions, and switch to an internal editor scrollbar only at a viewport-safe cap.
implementation: The prompt editor measures its content on change, restored prompt updates, and viewport resize; the cap is the smaller of 360px and 46% of the viewport height, with a 120px floor.
The studio root receives matching dock clearance so the fixed composer does not hide the lower content as it expands.
Long unbroken text wraps safely, editor scrolling is contained, and plus/Generate actions remain reachable at the bottom of the growing dock.

checks.docs_impact: mapped to images and client-efficiency; no unmapped paths

limits: No live production browser session, physical-device pass, or deployment was performed in this local change.
Existing Impeccable color/radius findings in studio.css were not broadened or suppressed; this change adds no new detector exceptions.
